# Flowtide.NET

> Flowtide is a .NET streaming SQL engine that continuously maintains query results as source data is inserted, updated, or deleted, and writes those changes to sinks. SQL compiles to a Substrait plan executed with persistent state, checkpoints, and watermarks.

Use these references to write Flowtide applications and Flowtide SQL. They describe this repository's implementation; check the installed NuGet version before using features from main. The repository targets .NET 8 and .NET 10. Use matching versions of the Flowtide packages.

A stream needs a plan, source and sink connectors, and state storage. With dependency injection, AddFlowtideStream registers a hosted service that runs the stream. INSERT INTO names a continuously maintained destination. CREATE TABLE declares planner metadata; it does not create a table in an external database. Flowtide SQL has its own supported subset and extensions, so consult the SQL and expression references before borrowing syntax from another database.

Start with the stream guide for C# setup, the SQL guide for complete query examples, and the expression catalog for exact function names and signatures. The linked .txt guides are UTF-8 Markdown served directly by the documentation site.

## Core references

- [Complete application reference](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/llms-full.txt): All four guides below combined into one file for loading the reference in a single request; generated API documentation and release history remain separate.
- [Building and operating streams](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/llms/streams.txt): Complete C# examples, dependency injection, direct builders, persistence, versioning, monitoring, distributed hosting, and testing.
- [Writing Flowtide SQL](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/llms/sql.txt): Metadata, catalogs, views, joins, subqueries, aggregates, set operations, top N, recursion, analytic windows, time windows, and distributed SQL.
- [Expressions and functions](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/llms/expressions.txt): SQL operators and signatures for scalar, aggregate, window, and table functions, including types, null behavior, checks, and restrictions.
- [Connectors and data contracts](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/llms/connectors.txt): Available sources and sinks, registration methods, table naming, required output columns, custom connectors, and connector-specific documentation.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/index.md): Introductory application setup.
- [State persistence](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/docs/statepersistence.md): Reservoir file, temporary, and Azure Blob storage; cache and checkpoint tuning; legacy storage options.
- [SQL reference](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/docs/sql/index.md): SQL planning and statement documentation.
- [.NET API reference](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/api/index.md): Generated API documentation for the repository's public types.

## Examples and executable specifications

- [SQL Server to SQL Server](https://github.com/koralium/flowtide/tree/main/samples/SqlServerToSqlServerStream): Two catalogs, joins, versioning, storage, metrics, health checks, and UI.
- [SQL Server to Elasticsearch](https://github.com/koralium/flowtide/tree/main/samples/SqlServerToElasticProductionSample): Destination identity, versioned indices, initial-load callbacks, and production hosting.
- [Custom source and sink](https://github.com/koralium/flowtide/tree/main/samples/CustomSinkSample): C# object ingestion, inserts, updates, deletes, recovery, and reconciliation with existing destination data.
- [All samples](https://github.com/koralium/flowtide/tree/main/samples): MongoDB, Delta Lake, OpenFGA, Aspire, Orleans, and monitoring examples. Database bootstrap SQL configures the external database; it is not Flowtide SQL.
- [Acceptance tests](https://github.com/koralium/flowtide/tree/main/tests/FlowtideDotNet.AcceptanceTests): Executable examples of SQL behavior under inserts, updates, deletes, checkpoints, and crash recovery.
- [SQL function registration](https://github.com/koralium/flowtide/blob/main/src/FlowtideDotNet.Substrait/Sql/Internal/BuiltInSqlFunctions.cs): Authoritative built-in function names, argument validation, and SQL-to-Substrait mapping.

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/koralium/flowtide): Source, package projects, issues, and contribution context.

- [Project structure](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/docs/internal/projectstructure.md): Engine, plan, storage, and connector internals.
- [Consistency requirements](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/docs/internal/dataconsistency.md): Source and sink requirements for consistent processing.
- [Reservoir internals](https://koralium.github.io/flowtide/docs/internal/reservoir/index.md): Persistence architecture and implementation details.
